body.statement: In the specified experiment \((\mathcal Z_k^2,\overline\Pi_{s,k}^{\,2})\), \(\Pr(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{coll}})=1/k\) and \(\operatorname{TV}(\overline\Pi_{+,k}^{\,2},\overline\Pi_{-,k}^{\,2})=4ab/k\). With equal prior weights on \(s\), \(RR_{2,k}\) has Bayes classification error \(\{1-(4ab/k)\tanh(\epsilon/2)\}/2\), and \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{RR}}\) has Bayes absolute risk \[\frac{ab}{1/4-a^2}\{1-(4ab/k)\tanh(\epsilon/2)\}.\] For every adjacent pair under \(\sim_{\mathrm q}\), both output likelihood ratios are at most \(e^\epsilon\), and the maximum neighboring log-likelihood ratio is exactly \(\epsilon\).
body.justification: The fully finite calculation separates the unavoidable collision loss from any nonexistent nuisance-entropy loss.
body.gap: Generic cover bounds do not identify whether a loss in this experiment comes from collision probability or from the number of nuisance profiles.
body.consumer: It supplies a reproducible, exact early-kill benchmark for the sample-level pair mechanism and its privacy constraints.
